unitTests.scope: Existing regressions plus planning/RTM/metrics, pairwise/CFG/fuzz, report formats, scope/failed/empty/malformed runs, schema pinning/reference/dialect/JSON validation, load deadlines and audit-ledger integrity. Extended optional dependencies installed in isolated maintenance environment.

forwardTrials.observed: Six requirements, three use cases, planned acceptance checks and CPM; five structural checks passed, four invalid-plan mutations rejected. Product/source and user acceptance remained unexecuted.
Found typed return-value defect, reproduced a runtime contract failure and rejected failed-invocation SARIF without editing supplied sources.
Applied seven LINDDUN categories and practical controls; preserved two license-review unknowns rather than claiming clearance.

independentReview.rechecks: Original report-code/XML/deadline reproductions rejected or handled as appropriate; schema relative-base/nonfinite/referenced-schema controls pass after fixes. Additional bare-$ref and dialect regression cases included.

priorRuntimeAudit.resolution: Mandatory manifest inventory; structured malformed/overflow AI metrics; narrowed endpoint-only input-binding guarantee and rejection of legacy ambiguous evidence. No immutable execution claim.

historicalRoutingEvaluation.limitations: Single small labelled routing set, one run per version; no global SWE effectiveness or cross-project performance claim.

limits: No production deployment, hosted CI run, live network pentest or authenticated vendor-platform validation was performed.
